name: ip-illustration-character-system
title_zh: 一套图库喂出你专属的漫画分身
tagline_zh: 不再每次从零画头像。定一次角色锚点，之后配图、贴纸、表情包、证件照边框全用同一张脸，连梗图换脸都认你。
tagline_en: Stop redrawing your mascot from scratch. Lock the look once, then reuse it across illustrations, stickers.
desc_en: Create a reusable personal IP and an all-in-one visual asset system: character anchors, article illustrations, infographics, photo fusion, stickers, folder icons, stationery, Polaroid frames, avatars, expression packs, and reference-meme subject replacement in Mengli, source-meme, 3D, pixel, or another user-chosen style. Use for personal mascots, reaction images, meme remakes, or any request that
why_zh: 把角色设定固化成可复用资产，而非一次性出图。锚点驱动，风格可换，后续所有衍生图都长在同一张脸上。
why_en: Turns your character into a reusable visual anchor, not a one-off image. Style-swappable, consistent across every derived asset.
limit_zh: 只负责生成视觉资产，不产出角色故事或世界观文案。需要你提供至少一张清晰的正面参考图；像素/3D风格对原图细节要求高。
limit_en: Generates visuals only—no lore or story writing. Needs one clear front-facing reference photo; blurry source breaks pixel/3D styles.
title_en: One character sheet to rule all your stickers, avatars.
